PROVINCE NO. 2. A WHOLE WORLD OF ITS OWN.

Color. Devotion.
A deeper Nepal.

Step into courtyards painted with stories. Follow a quiet path beside a pond, then leave the city for the forest. The southern plains hold a Nepal that feels close, colorful and alive.

Meet Mithila through its art, the plains through their many languages, and each place through the people who know it. Stay curious. Let local voices lead.

Formerly Province No. 2 · Nepal’s southern Terai, beside Koshi, Bagmati and Bihar, India.
